messages:
Maya J: Paging INF-421 — inference-service p95 jumped from ~80ms to 550ms in us-west-2 around 09:12UTC. Seeing failed requests up ~4%. Can oncall take a look?
Samir K: I'm on it. Looking at autoscaler logs + pod restart events.
Ops-bot: Incident INF-421 created by Maya J at 09:12UTC. Linked alert: latency_p95>300ms (us-west-2).
Tom C: I see a spike in GPU memory pressure on pool-gpu-a. One node OOM-killed a process, leading to request queueing. Investigating kernel OOM or driver resets.
Samir K: I hopped traffic to fallback model variant (cpu-safe) at 09:18UTC to maintain availability — p95 dropped to 220ms but throughput limited. Putting mitigation in #oncall-bridge.
oncall-bridge: Samir -> handoff to SRE for root cause + impact calc.
Rachel P: Support report: ~12 customers saw increased latency; 3 reported timeouts. Customer-facing mitigation note drafted and posted to status.redwood.ai at 09:25UTC.
Maya J: Thanks — good catch on fallback. Can we collect request logs + KV cache stats for the 09:10-09:25 window for RCA timeline?
Tom C: Pulling logs now. Also capturing node metrics and dmesg from affected host. Will paste artifact links when ready.
Ops-bot: Artifact bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/INF-421/artifacts/2755001234-logs.tar.gz
Samir K: Quick summary for triage: cause looks like a driver-level memory leak triggered by a recent kernel upgrade on node images (k8s pool-gpu-a). Injected restart loop led to KV cache warmup thundering and higher tail latency.
Maya J: OK — proposed post-incident runbook: 1) RCA owner: Maya J 2) Evidence collection by Tom C and Samir K 3) Draft timeline by Friday EOD 4) Action items + remediation by next Wed 5) Postmortem review + sign-off with Eng, SRE, and Legal.
Rachel P: From support/customer impact POV: estimate 3 customers impacted with timeouts, ~45 minutes average degraded experience for others. We should include exact PIDs and customer request ids in the appendix.
Legal-bot: For customer-impact communication, please include no PHI and run the statement past Legal before public postmortem.
Maya J: Assigning tasks: Samir K -> collect autoscaler and node event timeline (due Thu 10:00UTC). Tom C -> compile logs + dmesg + driver versions (due Thu 10:00UTC). Rachel P -> customer impact summary + support tickets (due Thu 18:00UTC). I'll draft RCA timeline and send initial draft on Friday.
Samir K: Noted. I'll also prepare a short mitigation playbook to prevent KV cache thundering on restarts (proposal: staggered restart with backoff + warm cache priming).
Tom C: Confirmed. Also proposing a post-deploy smoke test that hits a representative KV cache path to detect driver regressions earlier.
Maya J: Proposed reviewers: Eng-Platform (Tom C), Eng-SRE (Samir K), Product (Rachel P), Legal (Legal-bot). Target sign-off: next Thursday EOD.
Rachel P: I'll coordinate a public status update draft after Legal OK.
Samir K: Quick note: we need a short-term mitigation to avoid full node restarts during peak traffic windows — moving that to action item A1.
Maya J: Adding action items to tracker: A1 (staggered restarts, owner Samir K), A2 (smoke test + CI job, owner Tom C), A3 (postmortem writeup + customer appendix, owner Maya J/Rachel P).
Ops-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled (proposed): 2026-03-19 15:00UTC. RSVP thread: @Tom C @Samir K @Rachel P @Maya J.
Maya J: If anyone can't make that slot, ping me and I'll move.
Tom C: I'll be there.
Rachel P: Likely good.
Samir K: Works for me.
Maya J: Draft timeline notes: 09:10 alert, 09:12 incident created, 09:18 fallback to cpu model, 09:25 status posted, 09:45 node OOM investigation ongoing, 10:05 full mitigation (nodes stabilized + traffic normalizing). Need to validate exact times with logs.
Tom C: I'll fact-check timeline against logs and attach precise timestamps to the draft.
Maya J: Good. Once draft is ready, I'll post to #postmortems and request peer review. Aim: internal sign-off by Eng-SRE and Product, Legal quick review for public wording, then publish redacted public summary.
Rachel P: Suggest we include a short 'user-facing impact' table: customer, region, duration, visible symptoms. I'll prepare that appendix.
Samir K: For remediation priority, propose A1 (staggered restarts) as P0, A2 (smoke test) P1, A3 (long-term driver upgrade gating) P2.
Maya J: Agreed. Assigning P0->Samir K.
Legal-bot: Reminder: run any public-facing postmortem text through Legal review channel before publishing.
Maya J: Thanks everyone. I'll create the initial draft by Friday and link artifacts. Marking this thread as the authoritative mitigation -> postmortem handoff.
Ops-bot: Incident INF-421 status set to: mitigated.
Samir K: Closing loop on this thread — will update with artifact links + PRs for fixes. :white_check_mark:
